propositions: Guide markdown files for plan authoring and code review are inaccessible when rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP and run against a project lacking a docs/ directory, because explain_guide and explain_criterion resolve via config.repo_root() which points to the consuming project, not the rebar package.

Author guides must be moved into the package (src/rebar/_guides/) and loaded via importlib.resources to achieve installability and repo-root independence, matching the OSS convention already used by rebar for criteria_routing.json.

The AUTHOR_GUIDES mapping must change from dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] (path components under docs/) to dict[str, str] (bare filenames), and explain_guide() must use resources.files('rebar._guides') instead of accepting repo_root_path.

explain_criterion() must render criterion sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, while preserving overlay project criteria resolution via load_criteria(repo_root_path).
Thin pointer files in docs/ directory preserve backward compatibility for existing documentation links and cross-references.
CLI (rebar explain plan|review|<id>), library (registry.explain_guide/explain_criterion), and MCP (explain_criterion tool) must all succeed without a docs/ directory present in REBAR_ROOT.
